title: Imbuing Station
description:
The Imbuing Station is used to create Imbues that give your player on hit effects. Put a water bottle in the center slot and three ingredients in the other slots; after 200 ticks (10 seconds) it produces the imbue and uses up one of each.

There are currently 4 different imbues available:

- Fire Imbue (coal, flint, blaze powder): Sets hit enemies on fire for 10 seconds

- Poison Imbue (spider eye, rotten flesh, red mushroom): Applies Poison II to hit enemies lasting 10 seconds

- Experience Imbue (lesser magic bean, lapis lazuli, glowstone dust): Enemies killed while active drop 100% more experience (double)

- Wither Imbue (wither skeleton skull, nether brick, ghast tear): Applies Wither II to hit enemies lasting 5 seconds

The on hit effects only apply to melee hits (not arrows). You can only have one imbue active at a time. Drinking another one while one is still active will cancel the first one. All imbues last 20 minutes.

The station can also turn a cobblestone in the center slot (with a water bottle, vine and bone meal) into mossy cobblestone.
